context: Hina makes silly faces with Sho, focusing on body parts.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、頭、ぐるぐる、回して。
lines.en: Sho, spin your head around and around!
lines.style: Bright, eager opening. Quick tempo, infectious energy. Natural childish lisp and lightness in the voice. Reaches toward him with genuine warmth, not performing—the real joy of having his attention.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: My eyes are getting a little dizzy.
lines.style: Soft, small voice. Hesitant, observant—he's noticing the sensation as it happens. Slight wonder underneath. No complaint, just a small fact he's sharing. Quiet smile audible.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Look—I can make a silly face!
lines.style: Burst of excitement. Quick attack on the opening. High-pitched, proud. The voice of a child showing off something she just discovered. Unguarded delight, completely unselfconscious.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Genuine laugh woven through. Small, authentic appreciation—not performing amusement but actually charmed. Soft delivery, the real warmth of a younger child genuinely delighted by what he's seeing.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: It's so much more fun when we do it together.
lines.style: Warm, grounded closing. Softer tempo than before. The realization settling into her voice—less about the activity, more about him being part of it. Small, genuine tenderness at the end.
